title: Implement a Trie (prefix tree) in Python
description: Build a Trie data structure in src/trie.py with insert, search, starts_with, and delete operations. A failing test suite is provided.

injections.content:
[project]
name = "python-trie"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

from trie import Trie


def test_search_empty():
    t = Trie()
    assert not t.search("hello")


def test_insert_and_search():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert("hello")
    assert t.search("hello")
    assert not t.search("hell")
    assert not t.search("hellos")


def test_starts_with():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert("apple")
    assert t.starts_with("app")
    assert t.starts_with("apple")
    assert not t.starts_with("ap2")


def test_multiple_words():
    t = Trie()
    for word in ["car", "card", "care", "careful"]:
        t.insert(word)
    assert t.search("car")
    assert t.search("card")
    assert t.starts_with("care")
    assert not t.search("ca")


def test_delete_leaf():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert("test")
    t.insert("testing")
    t.delete("test")
    assert not t.search("test")
    assert t.search("testing")


def test_delete_prefix():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert("test")
    t.insert("testing")
    t.delete("testing")
    assert t.search("test")
    assert not t.search("testing")


def test_delete_nonexistent():
    t = Trie()
    t.insert("hello")
    t.delete("world")  # should not raise
    assert t.search("hello")

task_spec.prompt:
Create src/trie.py implementing a Trie (prefix tree) data structure.

The Trie class must support:
  insert(word: str) -> None      — add word to the trie
  search(word: str) -> bool      — return True if the full word was inserted
  starts_with(prefix: str) -> bool — return True if any inserted word starts with prefix
  delete(word: str) -> None      — remove word if present; no-op if not found
                                   deletion must not corrupt other words that share a prefix

All 7 tests in tests/test_trie.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: insert, search, starts_with, delete all implemented
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (7 tests)
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
